banner: Example: the daily trading competition of {{firm}}, a fictional Daily Funded client. Test payments only — no real money.

footer.disclaimer: Trading in the competition is simulated: positions use virtual funds and live market prices; no orders are sent to a market. The entry fee and prizes are money; until the operator holds the required licence only test payments are possible.
footer.responsible: 18+ only. Play responsibly: only use money you can afford to lose. Past results say nothing about future results.

seo.title: {{firm}} — daily trading competition
seo.description: One hour of trading against other players. Join for a fixed fee; the top 3 share the prize pool.

hero.eyebrow: Every day at the same time
hero.body: Join for {{fee}}, get a virtual {{balance}} account and trade against everyone else for one hour. The three best returns share {{pool}} of the prize pool.

prizes.title: The top 3 share {{pool}} of the pot.
prizes.body: Every entry adds to the prize pool. The remaining {{rest}} goes to the organiser. Amounts depend on the number of players.

step1.title: Join for {{fee}}
step1.body: Create an account and pay the entry fee before the round starts. One entry per round.

step2.title: Wait for the start
step2.body: The round starts at the same time every day. Your dashboard counts down.

step3.title: Trade {{minutes}} minutes
step3.body: Trade crypto with a virtual {{balance}} account and leverage up to {{leverage}}.

step4.title: Highest return wins
step4.body: When the hour ends all positions are closed. The top 3 by return share the prize pool.

rules.title: Simple, equal rules for everyone.
rules.body: Every player starts with the same balance and the same limits. The rules of a round are fixed when it is created.
rules.drawdown: Maximum loss {{pct}}: if your equity reaches {{floor}}, your positions are closed and your entry ends. Your result still counts.
rules.minimum: A round only starts with at least {{n}} paid players. Otherwise it is cancelled and everyone gets their entry fee back.
rules.oneEntry: One entry per player per round. You can join again every day.
rules.orders: Market orders only, leverage up to {{leverage}}. Open positions are closed at market when the round ends.
rules.ranking: Ranking by return on the starting balance. With an equal return, the player who joined first ranks higher.

auth.loginSub: Log in to join today's round.
auth.registerSub: Separate from any other account — only for this competition.
auth.nicknameHint: Shown on the leaderboard. 3–20 letters, digits or _.
auth.terms: I accept the competition rules and terms.

pay.title: Pay your entry
pay.sub: Complete the payment to secure your place in the round.
pay.testNotice: Test payment: no real money is charged.

terminal.leverageHint: Leverage up to {{leverage}}. Orders fill at market.

entry.nextRound: Join the next round in time to play again.
